opening.argument: The presentation ties Bitcoin growth to a structured recruitment and investment arrangement. It promises a weekly binary profit share while requiring a $200 trading-account balance and two direct referrals, one placed in each opposing team. It also offers a 10% commission on amounts invested by personally introduced participants, and instructs viewers to increase the weekly bonus by adding investment to the weakest team. These terms make recruitment and continued funding central to the proposed benefits, with questions directed back to the person who sent the video. The available evidence establishes the promotion of these commissions and tiered requirements, but does not establish that payments occurred or that any returns were achieved.
